title: No effect on tax refund or credit or reserve fund deposit to comply with constitutional provision.
bodyText: This chapter shall not affect the authority or discretion of the legislature to provide a tax refund or credit or make a deposit into a reserve fund in order to comply with article VII, section 6, of the Constitution of the State of Hawaii, as provided in the same.
bodyHtml: [§37B-5]  No effect on tax refund or credit or reserve fund deposit to comply with constitutional provision.  This chapter shall not affect the authority or discretion of the legislature to provide a tax refund or credit or make a deposit into a reserve fund in order to comply with article VII, section 6, of the Constitution of the State of Hawaii, as provided in the same. [L 2017, c 6, pt of §2]
